newsitem.title: USA: America Online eyes extra $44 mln revs - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: America Online eyes extra $44 mln revs - WSJ.

text.p: America Online will get an extra $44 million in revenue from two on-line merchants Amazon.com and 1-800-Flowers Inc, The Wall Street Journal said.
In Tuesday's electronic edition, the paper said more Web merchants are paying a sales commission as well as an advertising fee in exchange for prominent placement on high-traffic Web sites.

Amazon.com announced its America Online deal early Tuesday and the newspaper said 1-800-Flowers would also announce a long-term exclusive agreement to gain access to America Online's roughly 8.5 million customers.
